CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   C. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
